title: Components of a smooth projective curve over an algebraic closure
statement:
Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ a smooth projective curve over $k$ [def-pc-smooth-projective-curve], and $k':=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$, a $k$-algebra through the structure morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] containing $k$, let $X_\Omega:=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ with projection $p:X_\Omega\to X$ [def-pc-base-change]. Then:

1. $k'$ is a field, finite and separable over $k$ [def-pc-field-extension] [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension]; put $r:=[k':k]\geq1$.
1. $X_\Omega$ is the disjoint union $X_1\amalg\cdots\amalg X_r$ of $r$ nonempty open and closed subschemes, and each $X_j$ is a proper smooth connected curve over $\Omega$ in the sense of [def-sc-curves]: separated, of finite type, smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] over $\Omega$, connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] and of dimension one [def-pc-dimension]; moreover $\Gamma(X_j,\mathcal O_{X_j})=\Omega$.
1. For every invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] and every $j$, with $\mathcal L_j:=(p^*\mathcal L)|_{X_j}$ [def-pc-module-pullback], one has
$$r\cdot\deg_{X_j}(\mathcal L_j)=\deg_X(\mathcal L),$$
where $\deg_{X_j}$ and $\deg_X$ are the degrees $\chi(\mathcal L_j)-\chi(\mathcal O_{X_j})$ over $\Omega$ and $\chi(\mathcal L)-\chi(\mathcal O_X)$ over $k$ of [def-pc-degree-line-bundle].
